context.books: Path to the business's books folder. Passed as the first argument; the server fills it from GLEAN_BOOKS.

tools.name: business_status
tools.description: One-screen summary of the business: customers, jobs by stage, money owed, money past due, cash collected this month, and finished jobs not yet invoiced. Use for 'how's business?' or 'what needs my attention?'.

tools.name: find_customers
tools.description: List customers, optionally filtered by part of a name or email.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs, optionally by status (quoted, scheduled, in_progress, done, cancelled) and/or customer.

customer.description: Customer id or part of the name

tools.name: open_invoices
tools.description: Every invoice with money still owed, most overdue first, with days late. Balances are computed from payments.

tools.name: history
tools.description: Recent changes to the books, each with a timestamp. Use for 'what changed?' or before undoing.

tools.name: add_customer
tools.description: Add a new customer. Refuses duplicates by name.

tools.name: add_offer
tools.description: Add something the business sells, with its price (e.g. 'Lawn treatment, $85 per visit').

tools.name: add_job
tools.description: Record a job for a customer. Customer and offer can be ids or part of a name. Status defaults to quoted.

tools.name: update_job
tools.description: Change a job's status, dates, or description. Marking it done fills today's date if none given. Job can be an id or words from its description or customer.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Invoice a job. Amount defaults to the job's offer price; due date is issued date plus terms (default 30 days). Refuses to invoice a job twice.

tools.name: record_payment
tools.description: Record money received, by invoice number or customer. Amount defaults to the full balance. Refuses overpayment.

tools.name: undo_last_change
tools.description: Undo the most recent change to the books. The undo is recorded too, so history is never lost.
